basis: Named power of the late-antique/medieval Jewish magical corpus (Sefer ha-Razim, Sword of Moses, Sefer Raziel)

entities.name: The Seven Firmaments (Raqia of Sefer ha-Razim)
entities.source: Sefer ha-Razim (ed. Margalioth; trans. M. A. Morgan)
entities.note: Sefer ha-Razim is structured as seven firmaments, the first six each cataloguing their angelic hosts and magical operations, the seventh holding the Throne of Glory and the four hayyot.

entities.name: The Angels of the Seven Firmaments (Sefer ha-Razim)
entities.source: Sefer ha-Razim (trans. M. A. Morgan); Bohak, Ancient Jewish Magic
entities.note: The vast graded host of named angels organized into encampments across the firmaments, adjured in Sefer ha-Razim's spells for love, dreams, victory, healing and harm.

entities.name: Aurpnial
entities.note: Aurpnial heads the first of the seven encampments of the first firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Tigrh
entities.note: Tigrh is named as chief of one of the seven encampments of the first firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Dnhl
entities.note: Dnhl heads one of the seven encampments of the first firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Klmial
entities.note: Klmial commands a first-firmament encampment in Sefer ha-Razim, in whose roster Michael and Gabriel are listed.

entities.name: Asimur
entities.note: Asimur is named as chief of one of the seven encampments of the first firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Pesakir (Psbr)
entities.note: Pesakir heads the sixth encampment of the first firmament and is described with the power to cross the earth at great speed.

entities.name: Boel (Bual)
entities.note: Boel rules the seventh encampment of the first firmament with forty-four angels charged with the realm of dreams and revealing their meaning.

entities.name: Ibnial
entities.note: Ibnial is one of the three princes governing the angelic host of the third firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Rhtial
entities.note: Rhtial is one of the three princes set over the angelic host of the third firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Dlqial
entities.note: Dlqial is one of the three third-firmament princes in Sefer ha-Razim, in whose roster the angel Nuriel is listed.

entities.name: Tuqpirs
entities.note: Tuqpirs heads the eastern encampments of the sixth firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Aparkm
entities.note: Aparkm heads the western encampments of the sixth firmament in Sefer ha-Razim.

entities.name: Margioiel
entities.source: Harba de-Moshe / The Sword of Moses (ed. Gaster; trans. Harari)
entities.note: Margioiel is one of the four angels appointed over the 'Sword' in the Sword of Moses, set to the Law and perceiving the mysteries of above and below.

entities.name: Vehadrziolo (Asharuyliay)
entities.source: Harba de-Moshe / The Sword of Moses (ed. Gaster; trans. Harari)
entities.note: Vehadrziolo is one of the four angels appointed over the 'Sword' in the Sword of Moses, charged with the Law and the divine mysteries.

entities.name: Totrisi (Totrusiyay)
entities.source: Harba de-Moshe / The Sword of Moses (ed. Gaster; trans. Harari)
entities.note: Totrisi is the fourth of the angels appointed over the 'Sword' in the Sword of Moses, alongside Soqedhozi, Margioiel and Vehadrziolo.

entities.name: Af Bri
entities.source: Tefilat Geshem (Eleazar ha-Kallir, from Job 37:11); Sefer Raziel ha-Malakh tradition
entities.note: Af Bri, the angel of rain (name from Job 37:11), invoked in the liturgical Prayer for Rain and carried in the medieval magical-angelological tradition as overcaster of the sky.

entities.name: The Teaching of Raziel (Sefer Raziel ha-Malakh)
entities.primary_domains: hidden knowledge; revelation; creation; astral magic
entities.source: Sefer Raziel ha-Malakh (Amsterdam ed. 1701; cited by Ibn Ezra before 1153)
entities.note: Sefer Raziel ha-Malakh frames its angelology, creation-midrash, names of God and astral magic as knowledge the angel Raziel taught to Adam after the Fall and to Abraham.

relationships.rationale: The angelic host is organized by and inhabits the seven-firmament structure of Sefer ha-Razim.
The angels are adjured as the operative agents of Sefer ha-Razim's spells.
The graded firmaments enclose the heavenly secrets the practitioner ascends to obtain.
The seventh firmament holds the Throne of Glory and the hayyot, locating the scheme within the Merkabah cosmology.
Sefer ha-Razim's preface attributes its firmament-lore to the book the angel Raziel gave to Noah.
Aurpnial is a chief within the firmament angelic host.
Aurpnial commands the first encampment of the first firmament.
Tigrh is a named encampment chief of the first firmament.
Dnhl is a named first-firmament encampment chief.
Klmial heads a first-firmament encampment in Sefer ha-Razim.
Asimur is a named first-firmament encampment chief.
Pesakir heads the sixth encampment of the first firmament.
Pesakir's swift earth-crossing power is invoked operatively in the firmament's spells.
Boel rules the seventh encampment of the first firmament.
Boel and his forty-four angels govern dreams and reveal their meaning.
Ibnial is one of the three third-firmament princes.
Rhtial is one of the three third-firmament princes.
Dlqial is one of the three third-firmament princes, commanding Nuriel.
Tuqpirs heads the eastern host of the sixth firmament.
Aparkm heads the western host of the sixth firmament.
Margioiel is appointed over the Sword and perceives the mysteries of above and below.
Margioiel is one of the four sword-angels whose adjuration empowers the Sword of Moses' recipes.
Vehadrziolo is appointed over the Sword and the divine mysteries.
Vehadrziolo is one of the four sword-angels of the Sword of Moses.
Totrisi is appointed over the Sword and the mysteries of the Law.
Totrisi is one of the four sword-angels of the Sword of Moses.
As angel of rain, Af Bri is invoked for the beneficent provision of the agricultural year.
Af Bri is a named functionary angel within the heavenly host.
Sefer Raziel frames itself as the conveyance of secret creation- and astral-knowledge.
The teaching is delivered by the angel Raziel to Adam and Abraham.
Sefer Raziel supplies methods for writing magical healing amulets.
Encampments of the firmaments are adjured in Sefer ha-Razim's love-spells.
Firmament angels are invoked in Sefer ha-Razim's healing rites.
The firmament angels constitute a delineated portion of the wider heavenly host.
